## Problem and change / 问题与修改

## Scope / 范围
APK / ROM / shared（公共） / documentation（文档）

## Validation / 验证
Commands, results and untested scope / 命令、结果和未验证范围。

## Review / 检查
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated / 已更新相关文档
- [ ] Applicable UI strings covered in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, or no UI changes / 用户文案已覆盖英、简、繁，或无界面修改
- [ ] Third-party notices preserved; no credentials, private keys or personal data / 保留第三方声明，未引入凭据、私钥或个人数据
